projectTitle: 51Degrees Device Detection, IP Intelligence, Human Confidence, and Identifiers for NGINX
description: Dynamic modules ngx_http_51D_module (Device Detection) and ngx_http_51D_ipi_module (IP Intelligence) for NGINX 1.19.0+ on Linux. 51D_file_path and 51D_file_path_ipi in the main context load the data files. In a location, 51D_match_ua, 51D_match_ua_client_hints, 51D_match_all, and 51D_match_ipi set a header to comma-separated property values. 51D_get_javascript_all serves a JavaScript property. Human Confidence and Identifiers need the cloud API. Install with make install
